admin.title: Admin panel
admin.lead: Run the platform: catalog, users, orders and settings.
admin.forbidden: This area is for platform administrators only.
admin.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the rejection.

users.blockReason: Reason for blocking (goes to the audit log):
users.deleted: Deleted: personal data cleared, orders kept.
users.confirmDelete: Delete the account of {name}? Personal data is cleared and listings are archived.
users.lead: Users: search, block, delete and roles.
users.deleteWarn: The account is anonymized and this cannot be undone.

err.AD_RANGE: The end date must be after the start date
err.AD_STALE: The ad changed after you opened it, for example an earlier save already went through. The list is refreshed: open the row again and check it.

err.BULK_COUNT_CHANGED: The number of rows changed. Refresh the list and try again
err.BULK_TOO_MANY: Too many rows. Narrow the filter
err.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You cannot change your own panel access.
err.CLAIM_NOT_PENDING: This claim has already been decided.
err.DEMO_TARGET: This action is not available on sample data.
err.EXPORT_TOO_MANY: Too many rows ({total}). The limit is {max}: narrow the filter.
err.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large: 1.5 MB at most. Give an mp4 or a webm instead of an image.
err.INVALID_PHONE: The phone number is not valid.
err.KIND_NOT_ALLOWED: This type cannot be set here.
err.KYC_NOT_PENDING: This organisation has already been decided.
err.LAST_OWNER: This is the organization's only owner and cannot be removed.
err.LAST_PLAN: This is the last plan on sale with this feature: without it nobody can buy a subscription. Create another plan with it first.
err.MARKET_TRANSITION: The request cannot move to this state.
err.TEXT_REQUIRED: Note text must not be empty.
err.NOT_DRAFT: The listing is not a draft.
err.NOT_IN_QUEUE: This item has left the queue; a task cannot be opened.
err.NOT_ORG_MEMBER: You are not a member of this organisation.
err.NOT_OWNER: Only the organisation owner can do this.
err.NOT_PLATFORM_OWNER: Only the platform owner can do this.
err.ORG_IN_USE: The organization still has objects or orders and cannot be deleted.
err.PLAN_MAX_MONTHS: The term exceeds this plan's longest term.
err.PLAN_PHONE_LIMIT: A plan that opens phone numbers needs a daily number count (above 0).
err.PREMIUM_NOT_PENDING: This Premium payment has already been decided.
err.REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason before closing the order.
err.REGISTRY_NO_TAKEN: This registry number is already taken.
err.REMIND_TODAY: A reminder was already sent to this person today.
err.ROLES_NOT_ALLOWED: These roles cannot be granted here.
err.SELF_ACTION: You cannot apply this action to your own account.
err.STATION_IN_USE: Terminals are linked to this station, so it cannot be deleted.
err.SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_PENDING: This subscription payment has already been decided.
err.TASK_FORBIDDEN: Only the assignee, the person who assigned it or the owner can close this task.
err.TERMINAL_HAS_DATA: The terminal has related data. Review what will be lost, then confirm.
err.TERMINAL_HAS_ORDERS: This terminal has orders and cannot be deleted. Hide it from the list instead.
err.TERMINAL_UNCLAIMED: The terminal has no confirmed owner.

home.lead: What needs a decision today, where the money is and what is growing.
home.commissionThreshold: Threshold: {n} a month. Above it the commission is announced at least 30 days ahead.
home.wallNote: If the people who stop at the wall do not subscribe, change the price or the free window.

alert.NO_ACTIVE_PLAN: No plan on sale: nobody can buy a subscription
alert.WAGON_UPSTREAM: The wagon source failed {n} of {of} searches in 24 hours
alert.NO_PROVIDER: {n} new requests went to nobody in 24 hours: no matching provider found
alert.STUCK_ORDERS: {n, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} had no activity for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}: contact the terminal or change the status yourself

decision.users: If it drops: change the acquisition channel (ads, bot, SEO).
decision.listings: If it drops: supply side, work with terminal and equipment owners.
decision.requests: If it drops: demand side, work with cargo owners.
decision.wagon: If it drops: check the wagon plan and the bot ads.
decision.reveals: Reveals down while visits hold: the free window or the price.
decision.wagonSeries: Wagon searches down: the source or the bot.
decision.orders: Orders down: terminal activity, commission timing.

home.mineEmpty: You have not done anything yet.
home.mineTasksDecision: These first: a teammate or the owner is waiting on you.

terminals.lead: Terminals and rail sidings, registry records included.
terminals.deleteWarn: The terminal is deleted permanently. One with orders cannot be deleted.
terminals.deleteImpact: Also deleted: {tariffs} tariffs, {reviews} reviews, {services} services, {slots} time windows, {inquiries} conversations.
terminals.demandNote: The 100 objects whose pages were opened most in the last 30 days. Unanswered means the customer's latest message has no reply yet, including follow-ups after an earlier reply. Conversations marked "No reply needed" are not counted. Call from the top down.
terminals.ownerKindNote: This filter gathers the rows onto one screen; it does not decide anything. Reading the owner from the name is not exact, so look through the list.
terminals.bulkWarn: Found {count} rows. Hiding is the safer choice: a deleted registry row returns with the next import, a hidden one stays hidden.

stations.lead: The official station registry. Fix coordinates here and the map picks them up.
stations.deleteWarn: The station is deleted. One with linked objects cannot be deleted.

orders.lead: Every order. If one gets stuck, force its status from here.
orders.forceNote: This bypasses the normal transition rules. The reason is written to the order history.
orders.stuck: No activity for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

reasonCode.IDLE_CLOSED: Closed by the customer after {days} days without activity
reasonCode.SLA_TIMEOUT: The terminal did not respond in time
reasonCode.NO_SHOW: The customer did not arrive at the scheduled time

orgs.deleteWarn: The organization is deleted. One with objects or orders cannot be deleted.

audit.lead: Who did what. Entries are never changed or removed.

act.inquiry-noReply: Marked a conversation as no reply needed
act.admin-subscription-remind: Sent a subscription reminder by hand
act.admin-task-assign: Assigned a job to a teammate
act.order-terminalCancel: Cancelled an order on behalf of the terminal

settings.lead: Platform settings. These used to be changeable only in the database.

hint.phoneRevealFree: How many numbers are free without a subscription (lifetime, not daily). 0 = none. The subscription price and a subscriber's daily limit live in Plans.
hint.wagonSearchFree: Free wagon searches without a subscription (lifetime). 0 = subscription required at once. The subscription price lives in Plans.
hint.helpAskDaily: How many questions a person can send to the AI per day.
hint.payDetails: Card or account number and recipient for the subscription payment. This text is shown to the user. If empty, the person is sent to the contact form.
hint.commissionThresholdOrders: How many completed orders a month switch the commission on. The pricing and questions pages say 100: update those texts if you change it.

listings.lead: Every listing by status. The moderation queue is its own section.

moderation.lead: Listings, companies, object claims and payments waiting for a decision.

reviews.lead: Terminal ratings and listing comments. Remove fake or abusive ones here.
reviews.author: Author

urgent.lead: Requests for a shunting locomotive, wagon repair or a crane. Close a stalled one here.
urgent.closeNote: The requester sees this reason, so it is required.

demo.title: Sample data
demo.lead: Sample organizations, listings, services and requests so the catalog does not look empty. Each one carries a "Sample" badge and has no phone. Reloading is safe: existing rows are updated, no new ones are created.

market.lead: Cargo posts, service requests and providers. Hide on complaint; the owner phone is shown here.
market.hideConfirm: Hide it? The request is cancelled, the profile leaves the list.

team.title: Team
team.lead: Who can open the panel and at what level. Only an owner can change this.
team.addHint: The person must already have an account: access is granted to the account with this number.
team.envNote: Set in server settings, cannot be removed here

err.USER_NOT_FOUND: No account with this number. Ask them to sign in first.
err.INVALID_PHONE: That phone number is not valid.
err.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You cannot change yourself: you would lose access to the panel.
err.FROM_ENV: This person's access comes from server settings and cannot be removed here.
err.KIND_NOT_ALLOWED: That organisation type cannot be set.
err.NOT_PLATFORM_OWNER: Only an owner can do this.

visits.lead: Last 30 days: how many visits and where from.
visits.accuracy: Location comes from the IP address. Inside Uzbekistan this is rough: carriers route traffic through Tashkent address blocks, so the regional split leans towards Tashkent. The country level is reliable.
visits.noGeo: Location is not being determined yet: visits are counted, but not where they come from.

revenue.lead: Recurring money, expiring subscriptions, bank reconciliation and cancellations. Months are cut by Tashkent time; anyone who renewed is not listed as expiring.
revenue.noPremium: There were no Premium payments in this period.
revenue.noAds: No ad was paid for in this period: push ad sales or remove the ad slots.

deals.title: Deals on the platform
deals.lead: This is not our money and is not part of revenue: the price of the offer the customer picked in cargo, service and urgent requests, by the month it was picked. An offer without a price counts as a deal but not toward the volume.
deals.empty: No deals in the last 12 months.
deals.decision: Number of deals: is the platform bringing people work. If volume grows but revenue does not, review the subscription price or consider a fee on deals.

decision.mrr: Compare with monthly costs (server, team, ads): if MRR is below them, work on price or acquisition; if above, the team can grow.
decision.mrrEnd: If nobody renews, this much remains at month end: the gap is what the call list is worth.
decision.atRisk: If these people are not contacted before the month ends, MRR drops by this much. The list: Expiring.
decision.revenue: The cash line: price, plan and ad policy follow this number. If this month's subscription money (the Subscriptions column in the table) is below MRR, payments are running late:

col.total: Total: did this month cover the costs.
col.subs: Subscriptions and Premium: which product the money comes from; if Premium is zero month after month, its queue can be closed.
col.ads: Ads: the price of sold ads, counted in the month it was paid (older ads with no paid date: in the month they start). If it is zero month after month, push ad sales or remove the ad slots.
col.payments: Number of payments: when manual confirmation starts to weigh.
col.renewals: Renewals: is the money from new people or from those who stayed; effort goes to acquisition or to retention.
col.mrr: MRR: recurring money, not one-off; growth is measured by it.
col.active: Active people: how many are affected by a plan change.
col.new: New: is the acquisition channel working.
col.churned: Churned: call and learn the reason (price, no longer needed, the source). Red when more than new.

decision.expiring: This money leaves unless renewed: call or remind down the list. The automatic reminder goes out by itself 3 days before; a manual one helps earlier.
decision.expected: Compare with the bank statement total: a gap means a lost or an extra payment.
decision.received: Short: ask for the rest. Over: refund or carry to next month.
decision.diff: Talk to each one; the reason stays in the audit log.
decision.noReceived: The operator did not record the received amount: such a confirmation cannot be reconciled with the statement. Remind them of the rule.
decision.refund: Cancellations where money arrived: the refund question is open; the agreement goes into the user's note.
decision.cancel: Many unpaid orders: are the payment details unclear, is the price too high, call the person who ordered.

expiring.summary: {count, plural, one {# subscription} other {# subscriptions}}, {sum}, end within {days} days
expiring.empty: No subscriptions end in this window.
expiring.daysLeft: {n, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

reconcile.emptyDiff: No confirmations with a gap: matches the statement.

reports.lead: Open the object and check it. Hiding or deleting is done on that object's own screen.

subs.lead: Who is paying, whose term is ending, who left. Search by PAY number, phone or name. Each row shows which plan was bought; price and contents are changed in Plans.
subs.daysLeft: {n, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
subs.revokeHint: Access stops at once and the end date moves to today. This cannot be undone.
subs.revokeWarn: The button works once a reason is given
subs.moneyReceived: The money really arrived (if unchecked, this row leaves the revenue sheet)

ads.lead: Side advertising: the platform sells and places it itself.
ads.note: Subscribers see no ads. No third-party code and no trackers.
ads.title: Title
ads.paidAtHint: The Revenue page counts the money in this date's month. If empty, in the month the ad starts.

renew.yes: Yes, a renewal: the buyer paid again
renew.no: No, a correction: no new money came in
renew.hint: If yes, enter only the new payment as the price: the earlier payment ({sum} UZS) stays in its month as a separate Draft row in the list. Do not delete it, or that month's revenue drops.
renew.saved: Saved. The earlier payment stays in the list as a separate Draft row.

ads.deleteWarn: This row's money also disappears from the Revenue page.
ads.delayHint: It appears this many seconds after the page opens. A smaller number gets more views but interrupts reading more.
ads.showHint: It leaves on its own after this many seconds. Set 0 and it never closes itself, it waits for the person.
ads.quietHint: After someone closes it, it stays away for this many hours. At 12 it shows at most twice a day.
ads.localeHint: Empty means every language. The banner wording lives inside the image, so put an Uzbek banner on Uzbek pages only.
ads.previewNote: This runs on your screen only: nothing is counted and the link does not open.
ads.previewNeedMedia: Upload the banner file first: there is nothing to show.
ads.previewStay: It never closes itself: you close it.
ads.bottomTitleHint: In the bottom banner the title is not drawn on screen: it is an internal name, so you recognise the ad in this list.
ads.bottomBodyHint: In the bottom banner the text is not drawn either: it is the link description for a screen reader, so say what the image says.
ads.mediaHint: An image, a GIF or a silent video (mp4, webm). On the page the video plays muted and loops. 1.5 MB at most: instead of an animated image (GIF) give an mp4 or a webm, several times lighter at the same quality.

rules.head: The banner must not contain:
rules.fakeClose: A fake close button or a fake X inside the image.
rules.fakeUi: A fake search box, a fake play button, a fake system message.
rules.lookAlike: The look of a part of our site: our colours or our logo.
rules.flash: Flashing faster than three times a second, or a large area blinking harshly.
rules.harm: Content not for minors, gambling, unlicensed credit.
rules.tail: Code cannot check flashing. Do not set Active until you have watched the file to the end yourself.

decision.views: Views: is the spot working. If the number stops growing, move the banner where people see it.
decision.clicks: Clicks: is the banner itself working. If nobody clicks, change the text or the image.
decision.ctr: Click share: clicks per hundred views. If it is low, revisit the price or the placement.
decision.closes: Closed: is the banner in the way. If the close share is high, cut the show time or raise the quiet hours.

placeHint.site-left: On the left of every public page. Wide screens only (from 1536 pixels): on narrower ones it is not drawn so the content is not squeezed.
placeHint.site-right: On the right of every public page. Wide screens only (from 1536 pixels).
placeHint.terminal-aside: On a terminal's own page, in the right column. Not in the terminal list and not on the home page.
placeHint.listing-aside: On a listing's own page, in the right column. Not in the listing list.
placeHint.site-bottom: At the bottom of every public page, phones included. The title and the text are not drawn: only the image or the video shows. It leaves on its own after the set number of seconds, and once a person closes it, it stays away for the quiet hours.

ads.subNote: Subscribers are not shown ads: with an active subscription you will not see it either. Check in another window, signed out.

plans.lead: Subscription plans: price, contents and limits. The subscription price and the daily number count are set only here: the subscription card, the pricing page and the subscribe prompt shown in place of a phone number show this list.
plans.note: Editing or deleting a plan does not change the terms of someone who has already paid: their terms are written into their own order. The last plan on sale cannot be deleted or taken off sale.
plans.empty: No plan on sale: nobody can buy a subscription. Create the first plan.
plans.name: Name
plans.limitHint: Required for a plan that opens phone numbers: how many numbers a subscriber can reveal a day. Not needed for a wagon-search-only plan.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.go: g, then a letter: go to a section
keys.search: / : the search box on the page

palette.placeholder: PAY-1042, YS-1041, SR-12, UR-1001, phone, organisation, terminal, name or page
palette.error: Server search failed, the page list still works

table.bulkReason: Reason (written to the audit log and shown to the owner)
table.bulkBlockReason: Reason for blocking (written to the audit log)
table.bulkTooMany: At most 500 rows at a time. Reduce the selection.
table.exportHint: Current filter and order, at most 5000 rows
table.exportTooMany: Too many rows to export: at most {max}. Narrow the filter.
table.exportOwnerOnly: Personal data: export is owner only
table.keyboardHint: j/k row, Enter open, x select

money.tariffHint: If the price is stale, remind the owner.
money.orgHint: A paying organisation: priority in the check queue, leniency in a dispute; if a commission is introduced, it is counted from here.
money.premiumHint: Withdrawing a paid listing raises a refund question: talk to the owner first.
money.userHint: On a complaint or refund request look here: did they pay, is there abuse.

listing.noEdit: The owner edits the listing text. Here only the decision: approve, reject or withdraw.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.placeholder: Call outcome, agreement, suspicion. Only the team sees this.
notes.empty: No notes yet. This is for reminders only the team sees: call outcome, agreement, suspicion.
notes.ownerOnly: Only the owner can delete a note

tasks.pageOnly: Only the rows on this page were filtered.

decision.mine: What to open first today: what is assigned to me, overdue first.
decision.assign: No job is left without an owner: who answers for it is shown here.

system.lead: Server, database, wagon source, queues, daily cycle, errors. Next to each row is what to do.
system.shaMismatch: web and API on different commits
system.hoursAgo: {n, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
system.resultLine: keys {keys}, sessions {sessions}, codes {codes}, notifications {notes}, reminders {reminded}, expired listings {expired}, stale queues {stale}
system.notYet: Has not run since the process started.
system.dailyFailed: The cycle ended with an error: {error}
system.errEmpty: No errors since the process started.
system.tgNone: No messages sent since the process started.

decision.sha: If the two differ, the deploy is unfinished or half done: check GitHub Actions.
decision.started: On an unexpected restart, check the errors block and memory.
decision.memory: Above 80% of the 512 MB limit the container may be killed: a leak or mem_limit.
decision.db: Slower than 300 ms: check the server (disk, other containers, a long query).
decision.dbDown: Check the server now: docker compose ps and the db logs.
decision.dbSize: Disk planning; the backup is about this size too.
decision.wagonNotConfigured: The D_RAILWAY_* secrets are missing from the deploy: wagon search does not work.
decision.wagonErrors: Many errors: call d-railway; if needed, take the wagon plan off sale for a while (Plans).
decision.wagonStale: No success for 24 hours: the source is fully down.
decision.queues: A stale queue: assign it to a teammate (Moderation).
decision.daily: Older than 26 hours: the cycle has stopped; restart the api container and check the log.
decision.dailyReminded: If reminders are 0 while subscriptions are expiring, check the automatic reminder.
decision.errors: If the same code repeats, fix that path; for INTERNAL, docker logs api.
decision.telegram: If the last message failed: BOT_TOKEN and the bot logs; on 401 the token has changed.
decision.adsActive: Is the slot sold: if zero, sell ads.
decision.adsExpired: Extend or close: the slot sits empty.
decision.adsEnding: Call the buyer ahead of time.
decision.plansPhone: No active plan reveals phones: nobody can buy a subscription, create a plan.
decision.uploads: Over 1 GB: plan a cleanup of old listing photos.
decision.disk: If free space drops below 20%: docker image prune and old backups (deploy/backup.sh), then grow the volume.
